about: hand-written: from agent-vault design 1, S6's outcome now has the installer run `repo-init --all` in every registered repo's clone, but neither the design nor its research provides that flag or any way to find the clones (`repo-init` takes one path; the design says to name the repos and run it per clone); story-cannot-ship. The overview is today's Purpose and Architecture sections, not as sealed.

defects.name: S6 depends on a `repo-init --all` flag and clone discovery that nothing provides
